anomalies.description: A line of police officers in full riot gear (helmets, face shields, body armor) confronts a crowd; visible tension and close proximity suggest active violent unrest or imminent clash.; Continued standoff with riot police and crowd; some individuals appear to be raising arms or objects, consistent with escalation during a riot.

A white pickup truck is surrounded by a large, agitated crowd in daylight; people are pressing against the vehicle, some appear to be striking or climbing on it, consistent with collective violent unrest.

A large crowd of people, some holding flags (including US flags), is densely gathered on a street, surrounding and confronting a silver sedan that has stopped or slowed in traffic. The crowd presses toward the vehicle, with individuals reaching toward it and appearing to shout or gesture aggressively; the situation escalates as smoke or dust appears behind the car around 44.5s, suggesting possible impact or disturbance. The behavior is collective, agitated, and confrontational, exceeding peaceful protest.; A large group of people is gathered on a street, moving dynamically around vehicles; smoke or dust is visible in the background (e.g., f2–f4), and individuals appear to be confronting or surrounding a white van with its doors open. The scene shows collective unrest with agitated movement, some individuals wearing masks or bandanas, and no clear indication of peaceful protest—consistent with riotous behavior.

The silver sedan appears to make contact with or be struck by something (possibly another vehicle or object) around 44.0–44.5s, as evidenced by sudden jolt, change in orientation, and emergence of smoke/dust directly behind it in frames f8–f10. The car remains stationary or nearly so afterward, with visible disturbance at its rear.

In frames f6–f10, multiple individuals are seen in close proximity engaging in physical contact near the white van; one person appears to be pushed or struck near the driver’s side door (visible in f7–f9). While not fully unambiguous, the clustering, postures, and motion suggest mutual physical combat rather than incidental contact.
